meta.title: Mountain Accommodation Ramzová — Luxury retreat in the Jeseníky Mountains
meta.description: Elegant mountain accommodation in the heart of the Jeseníky range with panoramic views of Praděd.

hero.title: Mountains that breathe luxury.
hero.subtitle: A sanctuary above the clouds where Alpine elegance meets Czech mountain heritage.

intro.title: A place where time slows down.
intro.body: For more than a century we have welcomed travellers seeking the silence of the mountains, the scent of pine and a comfort that matches the highest standards. Our accommodation sits on the slope of Šerák with a panoramic view of the Jeseníky ridges — from sunrise over Praděd to star-filled nights above the valley.

rooms.title: Comfort with a view.
rooms.body: Each of our 48 rooms and suites features hand-selected furniture, local timber, cashmere textiles and a private balcony facing the mountains.

items.name: Classic Room
items.desc: A cosy room overlooking the forest with a stone bathroom.

items.name: Panorama Suite
items.desc: Suite with an open fireplace and terrace facing Praděd.

items.name: Ramzová Residence
items.desc: Two-storey residence for families — private sauna, library and a chef on request.

dining.title: Hand-picked restaurants in the area.
dining.body: Our accommodation does not have its own restaurant and does not serve breakfast — we believe the finest meals are found in the local inns and mountain lodges we have personally curated. We are happy to make a reservation for you.
dining.note: Note: Breakfast and half-board are not included in the room rate.

video.title: Our mountains, seen by drone.
video.body: A short film shot above Šerák at sunrise.

contact.title: We look forward to welcoming you.
contact.address: Mountain Accommodation Ramzová, Ramzová 142, 788 25 Ostružná, Czech Republic

booking.title: Reserve your stay.
booking.body: Choose a room and dates in the calendar below. We confirm by email within 24 hours. No deposit, no automatic confirmation — every stay is confirmed personally.
